one_line: AI geopolitics divides, while firms launch new initiatives

themes.title: AI blocs split nations
themes.text: The United States and China are each building AI alliances, forcing other countries to choose sides.

stories.headline: Countries split as US and China create competing AI blocs

themes.title: Google AI search cuts traffic
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode shift results to AI‑generated summaries, reducing traffic to news sites and paying small fees to publishers.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers

themes.title: India adds AI to school curriculum
themes.text: NCERT launches a 20‑hour module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for classes 9‑12, developed with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur.

stories.headline: NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12

themes.title: SpaceX secures $40 billion GPU financing
themes.text: SpaceX completes a $40 billion debt round to fund graphics processors for AI compute services, partnering with Nvidia, Snowflake and Databricks.

stories.headline: SpaceX secures $40 billion GPU debt financing, launches AI compute contracts
